name: Ookouchi Rihito
source:
"I need you. If saying it isn't enough... I'll show you."

The all-too sexy prince, born from a miracle
Cool x Sexy x Prince

Member of HEARTiS and the complete opposite of Akira. He can put on a show so hot it's said to make women pregnant just by watching. Off the stage, he's rather calm and collected, and has never been involved in a scandal. He's also smart; while working as an idol, he graduated at the top of the class from a reputable private university. His parents are in charge of a major hospital, which is an open secret.

Hobby: horse riding, playing the cello
Likes: sushi
Hates: bodybuilding sports

[Translated from [url=http://www.entremets-cd.com/products/stalove]official website[/url]]
